pkgmetadata.longdescription: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It runs text, image, and video prompts through a local CLI or OpenAI-/ Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs. The build targets CUDA architecture sm_120a exclusively and rejects any other CUDA_ARCHITECTURES setting.
